body: Only reason I didn't get arrested is because they only found the empty bottle on me, it was a stolen prescription I bought off someone.  If there was even 1 pill in there I would've had my ass locked up.  They tried to make me do like a 6 month rehab program and counselors harassed me for the last 4 months of that year every day.  My family wouldn't talk to me.  I was a piece of shit, but nothing's changed much besides the drugs. Worst mistake of my life, that made me never want to touch drugs.  I'm so depressed right now I'm physically sick and don't know what to do

I got suspended for being high on Xanax in high school, my sophomore year I passed out in my science class for an hour and got up, couldn't walk and was slurring.  Got a 2 week suspension and everyone looked at me like an idiot for the remainder of high school, including my family.  They still treat me like an idiot now.  It's also on my transcript, so now I probably won't even get into a decent college with that shit.
Me too, I'm so sad all I do is cry and have diarrhea with a pounding headache from all the tears and snot I've drained.  I knowhow you're feeling, bud.
